problem.title: Valid Parentheses
problem.statement: Given a string s containing only the characters ( ) [ ] { }, return true if every opening bracket is closed by the same type of bracket in the correct order, and every closing bracket has a matching opening bracket.

events.text: String up to 10^4 chars, only ()[]{}. Target O(n) time. I'll push opening brackets on a stack and pop when I see the matching closer. Can you check the idea before I code it?
That approach works and meets the target complexity. Watch the order of your updates.
What should happen when a closing bracket arrives and the stack is already empty?
Good catch to ask. Yes, that case matters; handle it explicitly before updating your state.
What edge cases should I test first: a lone closer, a leftover opener, interleaving like ([)]?
Those are the right ones to test; your plan covers them if the update order is right.
